Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.

Rich striped meat — cook it hard; this is the System's cut, not nature's. The fat burns long in a lamp. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.

🔥 The fire settles. Bashir has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella says quietly "We've been walking past those." Oliver says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
